title: Lamentations — Instructions and Commands
content:
Lamentations — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

7 additional passage records · 7 quoted verse units. Read Lamentations in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct

Faith, repentance and allegiance

Uncertain · 2 passage records

Lamentations 3:40

Record type: Lament or rhetorical exhortation. Source section: Let Us Return to the Lord.

Lamentations 3:40 — Our way was searched and examined; let us return to the Lord.

Context and scope: Read the lament and its addressed city or people. Rhetorical and ironic speech is not a general instruction to reproduce the event.

Record type: Lament or rhetorical exhortation. Source section: The Lord Completed His Fury.

Lamentations 4:15 — Keep away from unclean people—call them—keep away, keep away! Do not touch, for they were set aflame and shaken. Say among the nations, “They will sojourn no longer.”
